summary: Final acceptance passes at 2bfbd373f. Both round 1 blockers are closed. Phase 1 now has a passing phase-acceptance result, and the Phase 1 and Phase 4 results audit HEAD itself, so no later commit exists to cover. All four gates pass on a fresh heavy-run: check-types, lint (0 errors, 1 warning), Vitest (98 files, 1494 tests) and coverage (92.08 % lines). The cut is 1681 of 3175 cases, or 52.9 %, against a 20 % target. The whole cut comes from the PM-approved blog merge, as report.md section 1 says. The D5 revert is verified: all 14 D5 files hold at least their baseline case count, and three new money-pin mutations fail. For all 77 K files, HEAD holds at least the K case count, except the approved blog merge, which three new post mutations prove still fails and names the post. The seven tutor-commission files are byte-identical to the track base. The pilot changed no production file. Every spec criterion (a) to (f) is met. Known items stay open by PM decision. Eight nonblocking notes follow.
